$description: Sterling's design tokens in the Design Tokens (DTCG) format, version 2025.10. Group paths follow the token names (surface/background is color.surface.background). The format has no modes, so each Color and Density token's $value is its default mode (Light, Default) and every mode is listed under $extensions["io.github.mcasey10.sterling"].modes, with the value it resolves to. The same block gives the name in Figma and the CSS custom property or class.

io.github.mcasey10.sterling.css: tokens.css sets the default modes on :root, the other color mode under prefers-color-scheme and [data-theme], and each other density under a class (.stl-density-compact).

primitives.$description: The raw color ramps. Hidden in Figma: components use the semantic Color tokens, never these.

color.$description: Semantic colors. $value is the Light mode; every mode is in $extensions.

background.$description: Page and app background, behind panels.

panel.$description: Background of panels, cards, grid rows, and input fields.

raised.$description: Background of surfaces that sit above the page: menus and dialogs.

hover.$description: Background of a hovered row, cell, menu option, or ghost control.

disabled.$description: Background of disabled controls and fields.

pressed.$description: Background of a pressed secondary or ghost control.

skeleton.$description: Loading placeholder bars. Decorative, so pair them with a loading label.

io.github.mcasey10.sterling.note: Loading placeholder bars. Decorative: pair with a loading label or aria-busy, never color alone.

scrim.$description: Translucent layer that dims the page behind a modal dialog.

io.github.mcasey10.sterling.note: The only translucent color. alpha/* primitives are 8-digit hex (#RRGGBBAA): neutral/900 at 50% in Light, black at 60% in Dark, where the page is already neutral/900.

default.$description: Dividers and the borders of panels, cards, and grid rows.

strong.$description: Borders people need to see to use a control: input fields, checkboxes, chips, and the grid header rule.

primary.$description: Main text: values, labels, and headings.

secondary.$description: Supporting text: field labels, captions, placeholders, and inactive column headers.

disabled.$description: Text and icons in disabled controls. Exempt from contrast minimums.

inverse.$description: Text and icons on every solid fill (accent, danger, buy, sell).

io.github.mcasey10.sterling.note: Foreground for every solid fill (accent, danger, buy, sell). Fills are chosen so this passes 4.5:1 in both modes.

default.$description: Primary actions, links, progress bars, and selected controls such as a checked checkbox or the selected tab.

hover.$description: Hover state of accent fills and links.

subtle.$description: Tinted background for accent areas: the bulk action bar, the selected menu option, and the selected tab's count.

ring.$description: The 2px keyboard focus outline on every interactive control.

row.$description: Background of a selected grid row.

row-hover.$description: Background of a selected grid row while hovered.

io.github.mcasey10.sterling.note: Hover on a selected row. blue/75 and blue/850 sit between the ramp steps so every text color on rows still passes 4.5:1.

positive.$description: Positive status (success, ready): icons and borders.

positive-subtle.$description: Tinted background for positive status, as in status chips.

positive-strong.$description: Text and icons for positive status on its subtle background.

warning.$description: Warning status (needs attention): icons, and the border of flagged cells and fields.

warning-subtle.$description: Tinted background for warning status: chips and flagged cells.

warning-strong.$description: Text and icons for warning status on its subtle background, and the over-target progress bar.

critical.$description: Critical status (error, destructive): error icons and borders, and the fill of danger buttons.

io.github.mcasey10.sterling.note: Shares the crimson red ramp with finance/loss. Destructive (danger) buttons use status/critical, never finance/sell.

critical-subtle.$description: Tinted background for critical status: chips and error cells.

critical-strong.$description: Text and icons for critical status on its subtle background.

info-subtle.$description: Tinted background for informational status, as in status chips.

info-strong.$description: Text and icons for informational status on its subtle background.

neutral.$description: Neutral status (draft, inactive): icons and borders.

neutral-subtle.$description: Tinted background for neutral status, as in status chips and tab counts.

neutral-strong.$description: Text and icons for neutral status on its subtle background.

buy.$description: Buy side of an order or trade, which is an action. Never use it for gain.

buy-subtle.$description: Tinted background for the Buy side chip.

buy-strong.$description: Text on the Buy side chip.

sell.$description: Sell side of an order or trade, which is an action. Never use it for loss or for destructive buttons.

sell-subtle.$description: Tinted background for the Sell side chip.

sell-strong.$description: Text on the Sell side chip.

gain.$description: A gain in a value, which is data: the up glyph and signed number in gain cells.

gain-subtle.$description: Tinted background for highlighting a gain.

gain-strong.$description: Gain text and glyph on tinted backgrounds, such as flagged cells.

loss.$description: A loss in a value, which is data: the down glyph and signed number in loss cells.

loss-subtle.$description: Tinted background for highlighting a loss.

loss-strong.$description: Loss text and glyph on tinted backgrounds, such as flagged cells.

spacing.$description: Spacing scale for gap and padding (scope: Gap), plus corner radii (scope: Corner radius). Published: applied directly in layouts.

2.$description: 2px gap or padding, the smallest step.

4.$description: 4px gap or padding, for tightly related items such as an icon and its label.

6.$description: 6px gap or padding, used by compact controls and cells.

8.$description: 8px gap or padding, the default between related items.

12.$description: 12px gap or padding, for groups inside a panel.

16.$description: 16px gap or padding, for panel padding, screen margins, and grid gutters.

32.$description: 32px gap or padding, for generous separation.

48.$description: 48px gap or padding, for page-level padding.

xs.$description: 2px corner radius, for very small elements.

sm.$description: 4px corner radius, for controls, chips, and fields.

md.$description: 8px corner radius, for panels, cards, and dialogs.

pill.$description: Fully rounded ends, for pill shapes such as filter chips.

size.$description: Dimension scale for fixed widths and heights (scope: Width & height). For heights that should follow Density, use Density/* instead.

4.$description: 4px fixed width or height, for thin bars such as a progress track.

12.$description: 12px fixed width or height, for small icons.

16.$description: 16px fixed width or height, for icons and checkboxes.

20.$description: 20px fixed width or height. For heights that should follow the Density mode, use Density instead.

24.$description: 24px fixed width or height. For heights that should follow the Density mode, use Density instead.

32.$description: 32px fixed width or height. For heights that should follow the Density mode, use Density instead.

40.$description: 40px fixed width or height, such as the grid's checkbox column. For heights that should follow the Density mode, use Density instead.

56.$description: 56px fixed width or height, such as the app bar.

1.$description: 1px stroke for borders, dividers, and underlines.

2.$description: 2px stroke for focus rings and other emphasized lines.

density.$description: Sizes that follow the Density mode. $value is the Default mode; every mode is in $extensions. Every value is an alias of a Size or Spacing step.

height.$description: Height of grid rows and header cells. Follows the Density mode.

padding-x.$description: Left and right padding inside grid cells. Follows the Density mode.

padding-y.$description: Top and bottom padding inside grid cells. Follows the Density mode.

height.$description: Height of buttons, input fields, and menu options. Follows the Density mode.

padding-x.$description: Left and right padding inside buttons and input fields. Follows the Density mode.

height-sm.$description: Height of small controls, such as small buttons and filter chips. Follows the Density mode.

padding-x-sm.$description: Left and right padding inside small controls. Follows the Density mode.

gap.$description: Gap between the parts of a control, such as an icon and its label. Follows the Density mode.

size.$description: Width and height of icons inside controls. Follows the Density mode.

padding.$description: Padding inside a card, such as a summary metric. Follows the Density mode.

gap.$description: Gap between the parts of a card, such as a metric's label, value, and caption. Follows the Density mode.

typography.$description: Text styles. Each is a class in tokens.css, named in $extensions.

Body-link.$description: For link text: underlined, so a link is never marked by color alone.

Label-link.$description: For link text: underlined, so a link is never marked by color alone.

Numeric.$description: Intended for tabular figures: enable Type settings → Details → Numbers → Style → Monospace uppercase/lining (the plugin API cannot set this).
